verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships Visalaw AI, a SaaS product, so a data region/residency choice is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions selecting a storage region or residency. The SOC 2 Type II and 'no data retention' claims are adjacent privacy controls, not a choice of where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
